rules: Constitution II and .specify/memory/engineering.md: runtime cveta2 layers and effect ownership are enforced by the import-linter contracts in pyproject.toml, scripts/check_architecture.py and tests/test_architecture.py; integration tooling lives outside the packaged runtime and must not become a runtime dependency. This delta adds a scoped executable boundary for the new test-tooling helper.

modules.responsibility: Find an ssl.SSLError behind wrapped CVAT SDK, urllib3, requests or botocore failures and render the TLS failure message with the k8s-infra CA remedy.
modules.interface: find_tls_error(error) returns the ssl.SSLError or None; tls_failure_message(error, url) returns 'TLS verification of <url> failed (<ssl error>); <remedy>' or None for non-TLS failures; StandTlsError is a RuntimeError, deliberately not an OSError, so live tests fail instead of skipping. Cyclic chains terminate.
modules.layer: Test tooling (tests/integration), outside the packaged runtime
modules.effects: None; pure inspection of exception objects supplied by callers.

modules.responsibility: Stand verification, seeding and live fixtures default to https://<name>.k8s.docker.internal and raise TLS failures as StandError, SeedError or StandTlsError with the TLS message; non-TLS failures are re-raised unchanged.
modules.interface: Existing cvat_stand.py and seed_cvat.py command lines and exit codes; live fixture skip-on-OSError behavior preserved for unreachable stands.
modules.layer: Test tooling (tests/integration), outside the packaged runtime
allowed_dependencies: cveta2 modules already used by the live fixtures
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by cveta2 runtime modules
modules.effects: Network and SDK IO against the shared stands, unchanged in kind; only error classification changed.

modules.responsibility: Evaluate the k8s-infra helpers' env output (now including SSL_CERT_FILE, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, AWS_CA_BUNDLE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS), classify curl TLS exit statuses and expose the shared TLS remedy to the gate and test script.
modules.interface: integration_curl_tls_failure <curl status> returns 0 for TLS statuses; INTEGRATION_TLS_REMEDY array; existing exported variables and exit codes unchanged.
modules.layer: Development scripts, outside the packaged runtime
forbidden_dependencies: stored credentials or CA paths in the repository
being imported by cveta2 runtime modules
modules.effects: Process execution of helpers and curl, as before.

modules.responsibility: Packaged CLI and API; unchanged by this delta and constrained by the new boundary check not to import test or script tooling.
modules.interface: Public CLI, API, configuration and dataset contracts unchanged.

contracts.rules: Exhaustive inward layers, adapter independence and SDK ownership for the cveta2 runtime; effect ownership via scripts/check_architecture.py and tests/test_architecture.py negative fixtures.

tests/integration/stand_tls.py imports only ssl; no cveta2 runtime module imports tests or scripts (module-level or function-local); negative fixtures show cveta2, cvat_sdk, urllib3 and botocore imports in the helper and tests/scripts imports in runtime are rejected.

checks.command: uv run lint-imports && uv run python scripts/check_architecture.py && uv run pytest tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: All 10 import-linter contracts kept, effect checker passes, forbidden-edge negative fixtures fail as intended.
Current tree passes; every parametrized forbidden import is detected.

checks.command: uv run pytest tests/test_stand_tls.py tests/test_cvat_stand.py tests/test_seed_cvat.py tests/test_integration_env.py tests/test_clearml_run.py
checks.expectation: HTTPS endpoints and CA variables are exported; TLS failures report TLS with the remedy; non-TLS failures keep their classification.

checks.command: env -u CVAT_INTEGRATION_HOST uv run pytest -q -m 'not integration' && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy .
checks.expectation: Full non-integration suite, formatting, lint and strict typing pass.
Documented commands, links and anchors, including the new feature Markdown, pass.

checks.command: INFRA_RUN_TAG=<minted tag> ./scripts/integration_up.sh && ./scripts/integration_test.sh tests/integration && ./scripts/integration_stop.sh, then cvat.py/minio.py/clearml.py --project cveta2 ls --prefix <tag>
checks.expectation: All live integration tests pass against the HTTPS stands with no skips or TLS failures; the run tag leaves no objects on any stand.
